messages.subject: RE: Fitting linear-with-plateau functions
parts:
Hi Alan,

 

The following code seems to work, although note that the fit does not include confidence intervals. You will probably need create  a wrapper for nls if you desire this kind of output.

 

Hope this helps anyway,

fernando

 

library(ggplot2)

linear.plateau <- function(TT, a, b, c)

   {

      ifelse(TT > c, a + b * c, a + b * TT)

   }

qplot(TT, SW, shape=1, data=seedgrth) +

   facet_wrap( ~ genotype, ncol=3) +

   geom_smooth(method = "nls", size = I(1), se = FALSE,

               formula = y ~ linear.plateau(x, a, b, c), start = list(a = 0, b = 0.3, c = 900),
trace = T, control = list(warnOnly = T, minFactor = 1/2048))
